package rulefixtures

import "strings"

// scenario for make_map_inside_hot_loop_same_shape: make(map[K]V, ...) scratch maps recreated inside loops instead of being reused or prebuilt.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario354Positive(docs []string) []map[string]int {
	var counts []map[string]int
	for _, doc := range docs {
		m := make(map[string]int)
		for _, word := range strings.Fields(doc) {
			m[word]++
		}
		counts = append(counts, m)
	}
	return counts
}
